name: Offline Parallel Hybrid Rendering
aliases: Parallel volume ray-casting combined with on-the-fly isocontouring
definition: A parallel rendering algorithm designed to produce high-resolution fly-through movies of huge time-varying volume datasets by merging volume ray-casting and on-the-fly isocontouring to minimize data communication overhead between processors.
summary: Offline Parallel Hybrid Rendering is a parallel image-order method that merges volume ray-casting with on-the-fly isocontouring to minimize data communication and avoid storing large polygon meshes.
